offers_products.reason: Sells software products: dealer listing platform, websites and marketing software sold on subscription.

offers_services.reason: Provides digital advertising and marketing services to dealers and automakers via its online automotive marketplace.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Car shoppers use the marketplace free, but consumers are a main audience; also consumer-facing tools. Dealers pay.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main paying customers are car dealerships and automaker advertisers buying subscriptions and advertising.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from monthly dealer subscriptions for listings and marketing products.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dealers and automakers can cut advertising and subscription spend when car sales fall.

big_ticket.reason: Dealers pay modest monthly subscription fees; sales are small and frequent, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the online marketplace platform and technology, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Most customers are thousands of local, often small, dealerships, plus some large automakers; main buyers are dealers.

asset_heavy.reason: Online marketplace and software business needs little physical investment in plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Dealers pay while shoppers use it free; consumer and organization answers are judgement calls.
